children: GT Biopharma expanded its private placement of Series M 10% Convertible Preferred Stock and warrants, increasing the stated value to approximately $8.61 million for a $7.75 million purchase price and adding a new purchaser. The amendment also introduced purchaser greenshoe rights of up to $34.68 million in stated value. The company had initially launched the placement on September 14, 2026, with an $8.28 million stated value for $7.45 million. In parallel, GT Biopharma granted registration rights to investors for the resale of the underlying common stock, with a new purchaser joining those rights on September 18, 2026. The transactions aim to strengthen liquidity and support corporate initiatives.
